children: AudioEye reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $10.96 million, up 7.2% from the prior-year quarter, while net income was $990000 compared with a net loss of $554000. Diluted EPS was $0.08 versus a loss of $0.04 per share.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Net income (loss) per common share - diluted”.
Nine-month revenue increased 8% year over year. Partner and Marketplace revenue grew 14% in the quarter, led by expansion with existing partners, while Enterprise revenue declined 1%.
Annual recurring revenue reached $43.3 million, up 12% year over year, with growth in both channels.
Customer count rose 6% to approximately 130,000, with gains in Partner and Marketplace and Enterprise.
AI tools and automation helped reduce headcount and lower quarterly research and development, selling and marketing, and cost of revenue.
